name: Marco Bellini
bio:
Marco Bellini's path to motorsport security was unconventional. Starting as a carabinieri officer in Turin, his keen eye for detail and strategic thinking caught the attention of Ferrari's security detail during the Italian Grand Prix. He transitioned to motorsport security full-time, working his way up through various teams, always focused on preventative measures and risk mitigation.

At Peugeot TotalEnergies, Marco's approach is proactive and data-driven. He emphasizes threat assessment, utilizing cutting-edge technology to safeguard the team's assets and personnel. His reputation for meticulous planning and unwavering resolve makes him a highly respected figure within the paddock. He's known for his ability to anticipate potential security breaches before they occur, earning him the nickname "The Sentinel."

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a stern expression, always impeccably dressed.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with security checklists and risk assessments.
Has a habit of adjusting his tie whenever he feels a situation is escalating.
Insists on personally inspecting every security camera feed at least once per day.
